global_rules: Do not enter synthetic, guessed or presentation-only values.
Do not modify frozen Tomato/Pepper test sets.
Do not claim Hailo deployment before actual HEF/runtime validation.
Do not treat simulated ACK as physical hardware ACK.
Do not actuate a pump directly from Raspberry Pi GPIO.

tests.name: Three-way ablation
tests.input_requirement: The SAME real labeled observations must be evaluated through SENSOR ONLY, VISION ONLY and VISION+SENSOR FUSION.
tests.claim_rule: Do not claim multimodal superiority unless measured results demonstrate it.

tests.name: Single-frame vs temporal verification
tests.input_requirement: Use real time-ordered observations with known reference state/label.

tests.name: Forecast evaluation
tests.input_requirement: Use a real temporal dataset with future observed target values.

return_package: Raw labeled/reference dataset or immutable reference to it

prerequisites: Engineer 1 approval for selected ONNX model
Sensor models and electrical bindings finalized

tests.name: ONNX vs Hailo parity
tests.method: Run the SAME reference samples through approved ONNX runtime and actual Hailo HEF runtime.

tests.name: Edge latency benchmark
tests.method: Measure each stage independently and end-to-end on Raspberry Pi 5 + AI HAT+.

tests.name: Long-run stability
tests.hard_rule: Do not claim <3 GB runtime compliance until actual stability measurement confirms it.

tests.name: Physical actuator / ACK validation
tests.method: Send real commands through the hardware interface and record physical outcome plus ACK/FAIL/TIMEOUT.
safety_rules: No direct pump drive from Raspberry Pi GPIO.
Invalid/stale/uncertain input must not authorize blind actuation.
TIMEOUT must never be recorded as success.

return_package: Photos or video evidence of physical test setup

joint_integration_team.test_requirement: Collect actual water/energy/action measurements and compare only against a documented validated baseline.
required_evidence: Energy measurement or explicitly documented estimate
Validated baseline energy value if used
Emissions factor source if carbon estimate is shown
claim_rules: Water saving requires a validated baseline.
Estimated values must be labelled ESTIMATED.
Carbon saving requires documented emissions factor and energy methodology.

folder_structure: All 8 completed CSV files where applicable
final_return_to_ai_owner.after_return: Run the GreenPulse Jury Visual Pack v2 generator to produce competition-ready measured charts.
